text:
ITEM 1 | Golden-orange cooked mass with shredded, stringy texture, fibers separating into thin strands, slightly moist with a light sheen, edges browned and crisp-looking in places, spread irregularly across roughly one-third of the plate's right-center area, about 9 cm by 7 cm and roughly 1.5 cm thick at the center | 120

ITEM 2 | Bright orange-red crisp, thin flaky piece with darker browned edges and a slightly glossy surface, lying at the lower-left edge of the main mass, about 4 cm by 2.5 cm and under 0.5 cm thick | 15

ITEM 3 | Thin bright green strands, slightly glossy and limp, curving through the center of the food mass with a few darker green tips, about 5 cm long and under 0.3 cm thick, sitting on and among the shredded food | 5

ITEM 4 | Small sliver of thin reddish-orange piece with a curled shape, moist-looking, placed near the green strands at the center-left of the food, about 2 cm long | 3

ITEM 5 | Smear of pale, slightly translucent whitish-cream residue on the plate surface to the left of the food, flat and thin, about 3 cm across, with no clear thickness | 3
